scores.evidence: The objectives did not change, and q2, q3 (o1) and q6 (o2) keep their objectiveId and Bloom level after the option edits. Every objective still has 2 or more items, including apply-level or higher ones, and e1 and e3 remain transfer items. As before, o1 is a create objective, but only pr-checklist checks it at that level.

hook-b1 sets a concrete problem in 3 sentences (「毎回同じ手順をClaude Codeに貼り付けていませんか」), and the ungraded hook-q leads into 7-1. But hook-q mostly asks learners to recall lesson 6 (its explanation says 「（第6回）」), and the second problem in hook-b1, research output flooding the conversation, gets no prediction.

The glossary entries now end in です (「Claudeが一度に扱える情報の枠です。」), and the terms and aliases have not changed. They still match s1-defs and s3-defs (「コンテキストウィンドウ（context window）」). summary-next now names the exact next lesson, 「第8回｜フックで守らせ、MCPでつなぐ」, which matches the cc-08 draft title.

measure.mjs reports 「prose 1931 (budget 1,200–2,400) · est 17.8 min (must be ≤ 20; estMinutes 18)」, and lint --strict shows 0 errors and 0 warnings. The s1-diagram now has 5 nodes and s4-table has 2 columns. 7-1 is still at its term limit: s1-defs defines 3 terms and also glosses YAML inline.

The shorter description in s2-skill (「変更を要約し、コミットメッセージの案を出す。何を変えたかを聞かれたときや、コミット前に使う。」) still models both 「何をするか」 and 「いつ使うか」, as ex-description teaches. ex-folder's troubleshoot now runs its commands one at a time (「`mkdir cc-practice` で作り、`cd cc-practice` で移ります」). The subagent half of the practice is still not demonstrated before practice.

Wrong options in q2 now also use frontmatter wording (b 「フロントマターの `description` に…」), so 「フロントマター」 no longer points only to the answer. q3's options are closer in length, and every wrong option keeps its feedback. q2 can still be answered by recalling the key that s2-invoke names just before it.

The edited distractors still each target one misconception, and their feedback still fits them. q2 c 「実行する前に、必ずユーザーに確認する」 gets 「本文は、スキルを使うと決まってから読まれます」. q3 c 「どんなときも、必ず最初に使ってください」 gets 「強い言葉では、どんな依頼に合うのかがわかりません」. q6 d 「最初に全部登録しようとしている」 gets the s4-pitfall reason.

s1-diagram (5 nodes) and s3-diagram (5 nodes) are narrower, keep their takeaway captions (「スキルの本文は、使うときだけコンテキストに入る」) and have no decoration. s4-table now has 2 columns (「足すもの：読み込まれ方」) that fit on mobile. The s1-diagram no longer draws the 「本文は読み込まない」 branch, so only the caption and alt carry that contrast now.

The task asks for transfer: the learner turns their own procedure into a skill, then delegates research and compares `/context` before and after. Every step has an expect, and there are a plain-text pr-checklist and a model answer (pr-model, with its reason in pr-model-lead). The hint ladder is shallow, though: pr-write, the create step, has a single hint (「7-2の `commit-message` を手本に」) before the full model answer.

summary-points comes after the exam. summary-next keeps the lesson-specific reflection (「スキルにしたい手順と、サブエージェントに任せたい調べものを1つずつ」) and now names the next lesson by its exact title, 「第8回｜フックで守らせ、MCPでつなぐ」. It is followed by 6 flashcards and askTutor suggestions.

The changes add no new factual claims. The s2-skill body still checks 「未コミットの変更」 with `git diff HEAD`, and ex-folder still makes the first commit that this command needs. The lesson 8 title in summary-next matches content/courses/vibe-coding/drafts/cc-08-hooks-mcp.lesson.json, and the diagram text agrees with s1-run and s3-defs.

The glossary entries now use です・ます (「拡張機能…しくみです。」), and lint finds no banned phrases or long sentences. Two small term drifts appear in the changed diagrams: s1-diagram mixes 「全文を読む」 with 「本文を読み込む」, and s3-diagram's label 「自分のコンテキスト」 differs from its alt and s3-defs (「コンテキストウィンドウ」). The ja-editor owns the wording.

The single jp locale is complete, and diagram labels are in Japanese. The s1-diagram alt is now more specific (「それ以外では本文は読み込まれない」), and the s2-legacy link text is descriptive. The 2-column s4-table keeps its header semantics (「足すもの：読み込まれ方」).

summary: This is a verification round (mode verify): review-scope.mjs exited 0 with 9 of 72 parts changed (21%).
